cards.q: Listen to the airport announcement and answer the questions.
cards.passage: Please. This is an official announcement from the airport administration regarding passenger travel awareness and airline policies. We would like to inform all travelers about a common practice in the aviation industry. Passengers should be aware that some companies use overbooking. This means that airlines often sell more tickets than there are actual seats on the airplane. They do this to ensure their planes are completely full. However, this policy can cause problems for travelers. Recent official statistics show that 50,000 people lose seats every year because of this practice. To avoid any travel disruptions, we advise all passengers to check in online as early as possible before their scheduled flights. Thank you for your attention to this serious matter, and we wish you a safe and pleasant journey.

items.q: Who is making this announcement?
items.explain: المتحدث قال: This is an official announcement from the airport administration — أي إدارة المطار.

items.q: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
items.explain: الإعلان كله يدور حول توعية المسافرين بممارسة overbooking وكيف يتجنبون مشكلاتها (سؤال الفكرة العامة).

items.q: What does the word "overbooking" mean in the announcement?
options: Selling more tickets than there are seats
Booking a hotel and a flight together
items.a: Selling more tickets than there are seats
items.explain: عرّفها الإعلان مباشرة: airlines often sell more tickets than there are actual seats — أي بيع تذاكر أكثر من المقاعد.

items.q: Why do airlines use overbooking?
options: To make sure their planes are completely full
To reduce the number of flights
items.a: To make sure their planes are completely full
items.explain: قال: They do this to ensure their planes are completely full — حتى تمتلئ الطائرة بالكامل (سؤال السبب).

items.q: According to the statistics, how many people lose their seats every year?
items.explain: الرقم في المقطع: 50,000 people lose seats every year. انتبه للخيارات القريبة 15,000 و500,000 — هذا أسلوب ستيب في أسئلة الأرقام.

items.q: What does the announcement advise passengers to do?
options: Check in online as early as possible
Arrive at the airport one hour late
Buy two tickets for each trip
Call the airline after the flight
items.a: Check in online as early as possible
items.explain: النصيحة: check in online as early as possible before their scheduled flights — سجّل دخولك إلكترونياً مبكراً.

cards.q: Listen to the conversation and answer the questions.
cards.passage:
Joe: Hi Jane, are you still planning your trip to Brazil?
Jane: No Joe, I had to cancel it. I was supposed to visit it in summer, but I changed my plans.
Joe: Oh, why did you cancel? I thought you were really excited to go.
Jane: I was, but I read an article about the country yesterday. The main idea of the text is that Brazil does not get tourists.
Joe: Really? Why are there no tourists going there? Is it because of the weather?
Jane: No, it is because of the environment. The news from Brazil said 200 million pollution was reached for 135 years.
Joe: Wow, that is a very long time to have such high pollution. It sounds very unsafe.
Jane: Exactly. That is why I decided to go somewhere else for my holiday.

cards.q: Listen to the talk and answer the questions.
cards.passage:
IKEA is a famous furniture company known across the world today, but its ideas were quite different when the company began. At that time, most furniture was heavy, expensive, and already fully built. People had to buy furniture exactly as it was. IKEA introduced something new, custom furniture that customers could assemble at home. This idea made furniture easier to transport, more flexible to use, and often less expensive. Some people still preferred traditional ready-made furniture, while others liked the new approach. The option to assemble furniture yourself became one of the company's most recognizable features.
The company's story began in Sweden, which is located in Northern Europe. Because IKEA expanded very quickly later, some people mistakenly think it started in France, due to the brand's popularity there. Others believe it originated in Italy, since Italy is well known for strong design traditions. A few even guess Hungary, because IKEA later opened stores in Central Europe. But in fact, the first store was opened in Sweden, the country famous for forests, lakes, and long winters.
As IKEA grew more successful in Sweden, it decided to expand to other nearby countries. In the early 1960s, the company opened another branch in a neighboring Scandinavian country. Some people think this happened in 1950 or maybe even 1975, but it was actually in 1963 when IKEA opened its first store in Norway. This was an important step, because it showed that IKEA's idea of simple, easily assembled furniture worked outside its home country as well.
IKEA stores soon became known for their large showrooms. Customers could walk through rooms that looked like real homes, bedrooms, kitchens, and living rooms, to imagine how furniture might fit into their own spaces. This made shopping more interactive and enjoyable.
Today, IKEA continues to grow around the world. It still focuses on making furniture that is practical, modern, and affordable. Although styles change and new products are introduced, the company continues to follow the same basic idea, furniture that is designed for everyday life and that customers can help build themselves.

It was heavier and stronger than before
